purpose: Own bounded private native subprocess transport for the existing browser session driver
scope: local pipe boundary checks and two retained actual IC/Chromium driver journeys
retention: Retain binaries, original session/profile claims, commands, failures and outcomes; do not rerun silently
limitations: caller explicitly selects binary, native key paths and browser signer
private pipe checks use child-process substitutes; IC journeys use owned local provider substitutes
no automatic restart, upload retry, new durable state or real provider qualification
